subject.title: marketplace-crons: Amazon COM Catalog API recibe 429 al buscar ASINs

question: Should recoverable Catalog API 429 warnings remain monitored only, or should marketplace-crons proactively slow or change Catalog lookup behavior now?
rationale: The warning is real after the merged mitigation, but the discussion says observed requests still completed and persisted ASINs, so automation should not choose the latency-versus-throttling tradeoff alone.

options.title: Keep monitoring until terminal impact
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical thread and only start code work when `Error buscando` or correlated `No ASIN found for this EAN` failures increase.

options.title: Tighten Catalog retry behavior now
options.body: Apply a focused change to use the existing retry helper or respect `Retry-After`, accepting slower Amazon create enrichment to reduce warning volume.

options.title: Retune the Catalog budget globally
options.body: Revisit the Catalog rate budget across Amazon ES/COM/SE and serverless concurrency, which is broader but more likely to address shared quota pressure.

recommendation.title: Keep monitoring until terminal impact
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical thread and only start code work when `Error buscando` or correlated `No ASIN found for this EAN` failures increase.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn owns the recent mitigation and is assigned to the issue, making him the best available routing owner for the next threshold decision.
